chapters.reason: The paper directly addresses the safety and reliability challenges of long chain-of-thought reasoning, focusing on preventing harmful outputs in LRMs.
The paper introduces SafeChain, a dataset used to fine-tune models to produce safer and more efficient reasoning traces, aligning with the goal of internalizing concise/safe reasoning.
The paper develops new safety metrics and evaluates 12 state-of-the-art LRMs on specific safety datasets, contributing to the benchmarking of LRM safety.
